summary: Recent events involving federal deployment of National Guard troops and federal intervention in D.C. governance have renewed focus on the District's lack of local autonomy. Advocacy groups are highlighting instances where federal control has overridden local decision-making, while also urging Congress to protect D.C.'s fiscal independence against legislative challenges. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
